Item.Name: SYSTEM_NAME
Item.Hint: Enter system name for the institution.

Item.Name: CODABAR_UNIT_SCHEME
Item.Hint: Enter codabar unit scheme A=Alphanumeric N=Numeric 8=Code128.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :institutions.codabar_unit_scheme = 'A' then
 set_item_property('institutions.alpha_numeric',navigable, property_true);
 go_item('institutions.alpha_numeric');
else
 set_item_property('institutions.alpha_numeric',navigable, property_false);
 :alpha_numeric := null; 
 go_item('institutions.tax_id');
end if;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
nullchk;
check_package_failure;
if :institutions.codabar_unit_scheme in ('A','N','8') or
 :institutions.codabar_unit_scheme is null
then
 null;
else
 show_error ('5121');
 check_package_failure;
end if;
if :institutions.codabar_unit_scheme = 'N' then
 :alpha_numeric := null;
end if;

Item.Name: ALPHA_NUMERIC
Item.Hint: Enter 'Y' to report alpha numeric in HL7 else N.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :institutions.alpha_numeric in ('Y','N') or
 :institutions.alpha_numeric is null
then
 null;
else
 show_error ('1017');
 check_package_failure;
end if;

Item.Name: CONTRACT_PREFIX
Item.Hint: Enter 3 characters that represnts the institution.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
Begin
 If LTrim(:institutions.contract_prefix,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ') IS NOT NULL then 
 show_error('0397');
 check_package_failure;
 Elsif Length (:contract_prefix)!=3 then 
 show_error('0398');
 check_package_failure;
 Else 
 next_item;
 End If;
End;

Item.Name: EFF_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter effective date in DD-MON-YYYY format.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
nullchk;
check_package_failure;
-- Check that effective date is >= today
--
if :system.record_status = 'NEW' 
then
 if trunc(:eff_date) < trunc(sysdate)
 then
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
END IF;
IF :term_date is not null and
 trunc(:eff_date) > trunc(:term_date)
THEN
 show_error('8045');
 check_package_failure;
END IF;

Item.Name: TERM_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter termination date in DD-MON-YYYY format.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 IF :term_date is not null and trunc(:term_date) < trunc(:eff_date) THEN
 show_error('8045');
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_INST
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.block_status in ('NEW','QUERY')
then
 return;
end if;
if :institutions.codabar_unit_scheme = 'N' then
 :alpha_numeric := null;
end if;

--
-- Check all fields are entered
--
if :institutions.inst_name is null then
 show_error ('0080');
 check_package_failure;
end if;
--
if :institutions.eff_date is null then
 show_error ('5002');
 check_package_failure;
end if;
--
-- Check that effective date is >= today
--
if :system.record_status = 'NEW' 
then
 if trunc(:institutions.eff_date) < trunc(sysdate)
 then
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end if;
--
if :institutions.term_date is not null then
 if trunc(:institutions.term_date) < trunc(:institutions.eff_date)
 then
 show_error ('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end if;
--
if :institutions.address_id is null
then
 show_error ('5006');
 check_package_failure;
end if;

Item.Name: INT_FLAG
Item.Hint: Check the box for International Address
Item.Tooltip: Check the box for International Address

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.block_status in ( 'QUERY')
then
 return;
end if;
--
if :addresses.addr_1 is null then
 message ('Err: First line of address must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
if :addresses.city is null then
 message ('Err: City must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
IF NVL(:INT_FLAG,'N') = 'N' THEN

if :addresses.state_code is null then
 message ('Err: State code must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
else
begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'STATE'
 and code = :addresses.state_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Invalid State Code ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then handle_error;
end;
end if;

END IF;
--
if :addresses.zip is null then
 message ('Err: Zip code must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
if :addresses.country is null then
 message ('Err: Country must be entered');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
